description: This PHP source file defines the CorporateBrandingController class within the OrangeHRM system. It inherits from AbstractVueController and manages the preparation of a Vue component for the corporate branding page, setting properties such as allowed image types, aspect ratios, aspect ratio tolerance, and maximum file size.

classes.name: CorporateBrandingController
classes.description: Controller responsible for setting up the Vue component for the corporate branding page, including various theme-related properties.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with properties like allowed image types, aspect ratios, aspect ratio tolerance, and maximum file size before rendering the page.
